**Agent Name:** WebSurfer  
**Step Number:** 6  
**Reason for Mistake:** WebSurfer failed to verify the accuracy and relevance of the data presented on Zillow when searching for property sales in Queen Anne, January 2023. WebSurfer interpreted the first visible data on the page as satisfying the user’s request and highlighted properties sold in December 2024 or other incorrect dates, leading to the wrong identification of the lowest price data. This error was crucial because it provided inaccurate information to the orchestrator, contributing to the false final answer.
